decisions: Compose the bounded Bootstrap dossier repair and prior reviews, preserving historical lineage and canonical-observer HOLDs.
After the actual long-path bypass was reproduced, reject raw requests above4096 bytes before normalization or generic dispatch; ordinary unrelated paths retain behavior.
Improve semantic navigation and Domain6 provenance, with validated full Tailnet public media URLs and no autoplay or authored script.
qualifications: AGY assertion that two-key verification is satisfied is not adopted: task/review completion does not itself establish all formal or whole-EV obligations.
AGY asserted disjointness without running a merge. Actual JJ merge and source byte checks are separately observed here.
AGY1024-byte example was not adopted; the existing4096-byte ceiling is retained and now fails closed before normalization.
AGY root-relative URL suggestion does not satisfy the full Tailnet mandate; validated absolute same-origin public URLs are required.
Do not advertise byte ranges, click-to-copy or decoder integrity without actual implementation and tests. Serving matching bytes is not decoding, acoustic playback or synthesis proof.
Captured unrelated Telegram claims are not adopted as build or runtime evidence. This pane is unsigned cooperative advice, not admission authority.
